summary: Westport Fuel Systems filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a product demonstration of its high-pressure CNG fuel system combined with Cespira's HPDI fuel system at ACT Expo 2026. The filing contains no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It is a routine operational update on a technology showcase, not a corporate event triggering special-situation classification.
